verdict.rationale: Alacritty is configured entirely through a plain-text TOML file. It supports importing additional config files, loaded in order and skipping any that are missing, which makes modular dotfiles and per-machine overrides practical. Live reload is on by default, and the same config model applies across Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows. Missing for 10: documented config file locations/search paths per platform, explicit guidance on syncing or platform-conditional config, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-machine portability (one user reported TOML-migration config gotchas).
